name: dapp_server
summary: The single-tenant dApp HTTP surface. Stdlib ThreadingHTTPServer on port 8520 serving flat HTML + HTMX. Three pages (/dapp/services, /dapp/mint, /dapp/wallet) and four APIs (/dapp/api/products, /dapp/api/balance, /dapp/api/buy, /dapp/api/mint). Bearer-gated writes via freetier_gate.require_token. Routes purchases through stripe_mcp (fiat) or sui_mcp (USDC). Routes mints through tensorchain_mcp (with optional SUI_FALLBACK=1 bridge). Every buy and mint crystal-anchors via inference_logger.log(tier='monetization'). Caddy on the droplet fronts TLS in production; the server only binds 127.0.0.1.
engine_pattern: Stdlib HTTP server. string.Template-style {var} substitution. HTMX-aware: HX-Request: true → returns just the inner panel; full page otherwise. Photo upload constraints: max 8 MB; MIME-sniffed from magic bytes (PNG/JPEG/WEBP/GIF/BMP). Forms accept either JSON body or form-encoded POST. Sui wallet-standard JS loaded from CDN client-side; address persisted in localStorage.mspc_addr. Bearer token persisted in localStorage.mspc_token client-side.

routes.GET /dapp/api/products: JSON list of product cards (PUBLIC, no auth)
routes.POST /dapp/api/buy: BEARER · {product, payment_method, amount_cents} → stripe or sui_usdc

expected_tools: _anchor(tier, model, scope, source_file, payload, rc) -> crystal_id

env_vars.MSPC_DAPP_LOG: set to 'quiet' to silence per-request stderr
env_vars.SUI_FALLBACK: honored by tensorchain_mcp — '1' enables Sui bridge on JSON-RPC -32601

substrate: in-memory request handling + delegates to stripe_mcp / sui_mcp / tensorchain_mcp connectors. No own database. Crystal chain entries written via inference_logger for buy/mint events.

inbound_callers: Caddy reverse proxy on droplet (TLS termination → 127.0.0.1:8520)
browsers visiting /dapp/* on either GentlyOS.io or trollz.fun (single-tenant; either domain may front it)
routing_connections.substrate_reads: studio/assets/_products/*.json for product cards; templates from studio/dapp/templates/
routing_connections.substrate_writes: crystal chain entries via inference_logger only

smoke_test_results_2026_05_28.products: ok — returns list of 3 product cards (avatar_nft, realestate_walkthrough, svg_xml_inference_app)
smoke_test_results_2026_05_28.services_html: ok — renders cards with Stripe + Sui USDC buttons
smoke_test_results_2026_05_28.unauth_buy_401: ok — POST /dapp/api/buy without bearer returns 401 with unauthed.html panel

guarantees: All write endpoints bearer-gated — never reach connectors without a valid TokenClaims
Photo upload size-capped (8 MB) and MIME-sniffed before reaching any model/chain
Crystal-anchored audit trail for every buy + mint, even on failure
Stdlib only — no Flask, no Bottle, no FastAPI deps
127.0.0.1 bind only — TLS/domain mapping is Caddy's job on the droplet
Single-tenant by design — no Host-header routing, simpler attack surface than freetier_callback
usage_example:
MSPC_DAPP_PORT=8520 python3 studio/dapp/server.py
curl http://localhost:8520/dapp/healthz
curl http://localhost:8520/dapp/api/products
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"product":"avatar_nft","payment_method":"stripe","amount_cents":100}' \
  http://localhost:8520/dapp/api/buy
phase: A.6 — public dApp surface. Pairs with freetier_callback (auth) + the three connectors (stripe/sui/tensorchain). Next: A.7 IPFS pin + on-chain indexer for /dapp/wallet recent-NFTs.
